capabilities: Upload pasted or dropped images to LskyPro and replace them with Markdown URLs
Upload images via right-click menu, drag-and-drop, or command palette
Batch upload all local images in the current note with configurable concurrency
Batch download all remote images in a note to local storage
Optionally process network image links and delete local source files after upload
extras: The README warns that the mobile attachment auto-upload feature hasn't been thoroughly tested and may have compatibility issues; the planned-features list mentions a known frontmatter override inconsistency between paste and drop handlers.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted images as local vault files, so using a LskyPro image host means manually uploading files and rewriting links.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on NekoTarou/lskypro-auto-upload, with LskyPro V2 API support
Special thanks to the following projects for inspiration and reference

summary: Image uploader that automatically uploads pasted, dropped, or selected local images to a LskyPro image host and replaces them with hosted URLs.
